description: Registers the Atlas side of the AWS Cloud Provider Access trust handshake. It returns the Atlas principal ARN and the per-registration external ID for the customer's AWS::IAM::Role trust policy, and the role id for MongoDB::Atlas::CloudProviderAccessAuthorization and MongoDB::Atlas::EncryptionAtRest.

FeatureUsage.description: One Atlas feature that uses the Cloud Provider Access role. A role that a feature still uses cannot be deleted.

FeatureType.description: Human-readable label that describes the Atlas feature that uses the role, for example ENCRYPTION_AT_REST.

FeatureId.description: Identifying characteristics of the feature that uses the role, when Atlas returns them, for example the S3 bucket name for a push-based log export. Not set for features that Atlas does not identify, for example ENCRYPTION_AT_REST.

ProjectId.description: Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies the project.

BucketName.description: Name of the AWS S3 bucket that the push-based log export writes to.

Profile.description: The profile is defined in AWS Secret manager. See [Secret Manager Profile setup](../../../examples/profile-secret.yaml).

ProjectId.description: Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies your project.

RoleId.description: Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies the Cloud Provider Access role. Atlas generates it when the role is registered. Use it with MongoDB::Atlas::CloudProviderAccessAuthorization and MongoDB::Atlas::EncryptionAtRest.

AtlasAWSAccountArn.description: Amazon Resource Name that identifies the Atlas AWS account that assumes the customer's IAM role. Use it as the principal of the IAM role trust policy.

AtlasAssumedRoleExternalId.description: External ID that Atlas uses when it assumes the customer's IAM role. The IAM role trust policy must require it. Atlas generates a new value on each registration.

CreatedDate.description: Date and time when the role was registered, in the ISO 8601 timestamp format in UTC.

FeatureUsages.description: Atlas features that use the role. The role cannot be deleted while a feature still uses it.
